about.title: About
about.bio:
At nine years old, Artem Kukharuk is developing the foundations of a composed and positionally intelligent defender — reading the game early, maintaining his shape under pressure, and competing with an intensity that belies his age. Artem started playing football at the age of four and has already taken part in numerous tournaments, gaining valuable match experience against strong competition.

Training within the Viva Cup youth programme, he continues to build technical discipline, tactical awareness, and strong match-day habits that experienced coaches recognise as key qualities of a promising defensive player. His dedication and performances on the field have earned him several personal awards, including Best Player of the Team, MVP (Most Valuable Player of the Tournament), and other individual honours.

As he continues to develop physically and tactically, Artem's combination of football intelligence, work ethic, and competitive mentality makes him a player to watch in his age group.

club.title: Club
club.name: Viva Cup
club.description: Viva Cup is a youth football club from Khmelnytskyi dedicated to helping children develop football skills, confidence, discipline, and teamwork in a positive and motivating environment. Founded in 2021, the club focuses on modern training methods, active participation in tournaments, and creating a strong team spirit for young athletes. Viva Cup promotes a healthy lifestyle and a love for football among children and youth.
